label: PARAMETRIC DESIGN CANDIDATE — no physical print, no coupon result, clearance UNQUALIFIED
generative_content: none — no AI-generated geometry; the concept image is a communication asset only

manufacturing.supports: none — every slice returned an empty warning
manufacturing.boundary: Local export only; no printer upload and no print start were performed.

efficiency_gate.rationale: Seven candidates sliced with the exact pinned machine and filament profiles. The baseline feature breakdown put 47.5 percent of all filament into internal solid infill and a further 11.1 percent into internal bridging, because eight recesses are cut to eight different depths and every solid layer spans the full footprint. The levers that follow are footprint and shell count, not plate thickness.
efficiency_gate.protected_verified: All eight recess diameters measured by sectioning each mesh at z = 4.8 mm; identical across baseline, B1 and B2. audit-mesh returns PASS at the release profile for both variants.

selected.process_status: qualified 0.20 mm layer height and nozzle; shell thickness 1.2 -> 0.8 mm is not the pinned profile
selected.basis: Pareto set of one under the qualified-layer-height constraint.

rejected.reason: Costs 3.3 percent MORE material: the 1.2 mm bottom shell rounds up to 5 layers = 1.40 mm at 0.28 mm.
Buys only 6 minutes and 0.9 g over B1 while sinking 1c, 2c and 5c coins up to 2.13 mm deeper.

rejected.lever: B2 geometry on the 0.28 mm layer
rejected.reason: 6 minutes faster than D1 but 6.8 g heavier, and it needs a layer height outside MM-R3-K3MAX-PETG-0P4-0P20-2026-08-31.
A 7.4 degree sloped plate over an open cavity would need support; the design is support-free today.

efficiency_gate.next_step: Human slicer-preflight gate: accept D1 for the MVP package and confirm the thinner under-floor beneath the 50c recess (0.8 mm bottom skin + ~0.4 mm sparse + 0.8 mm top skin, where the baseline was fully solid) is acceptable, or raise under_floor_mm to 2.4 mm and re-slice.
